## **Other Ways to Check KE Bill Online**


### **Checking KE Bill Through the KE Website**


The official KE website provides a reliable way to


[check electricity bills](https://udhaar.pk/pay-k-electric-bill-online/) online. Here’s how:


1. Visit the KE website


2. Open the “Billing Services” or “Duplicate Bill” section.


3. Enter your 13-digit account number.


4. Click “View Bill”.


5. You can then download or print the ke online bill.


This method is commonly searched as ke bill online check, k electric online bill, and ke electric bill check.

1. Send a message like “Bill”.

3. Receive your bill instantly.
